name: Zayed University
englishBachelors: Zayed lists English as the language of its degree programmes. The curriculum includes Arabic, and Media and Communication has a separate Arabic entry requirement.
note: Both Abu Dhabi and Dubai campuses are co-educational. International students apply through a separate direct route and compete for available places.
summary: Federal university with campuses in Abu Dhabi and Dubai and six colleges offering bachelor's degrees in design, business, media, international studies, health sciences and IT.
about: The 2027–28 criteria distinguish the full IB Diploma from IB Course Results. If you are applying from abroad, use Zayed’s direct international route, not NAPO. The international checklist and dated degree criteria give different test scores. The profile photo shows the Dubai campus.

ib.text: 2027–28 minimum: full Diploma 24 points; Course Results 21 points, with two degree-related subjects at grade 4 or above. Degree and international application requirements are separate.

notes: Fall 2027: Zayed announced that applications through NAPO are open. Its separate international application page still has no confirmed opening or closing date. Do not use the NAPO date for the international route.

International applicants: the application page asks for an IELTS or TOEFL iBT certificate and an SAT Math certificate. The older e-services checklist lists Academic IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 71, plus SAT Math 750. These differ from the dated 2027–28 degree criteria. Confirm which English score and SAT Math rule Zayed applies to your application before booking a test or paying the fee.

The dated criteria do not give an IB-to-percentage conversion or say which IB English or mathematics subjects can replace tests for an international applicant. Ask about your subjects and whether predicted grades may be used before final results.
For school records from outside the UAE, the application page lists final reports for Grades 10–12, attestations and UAE equivalency. Check the official documents list for your situation.
The published international rate is AED 2,500 per credit, plus AED 250 and VAT to apply (AED 262.50 on the service card). The fee page does not identify a 2027–28 rate.
Admission is competitive: higher results and more recent school graduation are prioritised within available places.

Information Technology (Security and Network Technologies): Zayed’s dated 2027–28 degree criteria list Grade 12 English 80% or test-centre TOEFL iBT 72, and Grade 12 mathematics 80% or SAT Math 530. The older international checklist differs, as noted above.
Information Technology costs AED 300,000 at the current 120-credit international rate, excluding the application fee and living costs. Confirm the 2027–28 rate.

Information Technology is listed in Abu Dhabi or Dubai. The teaching page also describes Web and Mobile Application Development, but the current admissions list does not name it. Check whether it is taking new students and at which campus.

faculties.name: College of Arts and Creative Enterprises
faculties.line: Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Visual Arts; Architecture asks 80% Maths, others none.

faculties.name: College of Business
faculties.line: Accounting, Finance, Marketing; 80% in English and Maths (or SAT Math 530).

faculties.name: College of Communication and Media Sciences
faculties.line: Three concentrations; 80% in English and in Arabic, no Maths needed.

faculties.name: College of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: International Studies (two concentrations); 80% in English, no Maths or science.

faculties.name: College of Natural and Health Sciences
faculties.line: Psychology, Public Health, Environmental Science; Maths 80% and, for some, one science at 80%.

faculties.name: College of Technological Innovation
faculties.line: Information Technology, Information Systems and Technology Management, and Intelligent Systems Engineering.

languageOfInstruction.note: Zayed identifies English as its degree teaching language. Arabic is included in the curriculum; Media and Communication also has an Arabic entry requirement.
